attacks.claim: The claim that app 9.3 works with both 4.7 and 4.8 units has no QA row. Most units will still be on 4.7 when 9.3 ships, so this is the dominant state early in the rollout. The 4.7-edit-then-re-upgrade schedule path is also untested.
attacks.evidence: "App 9.3 works with both 4.7 and 4.8 units; no app rollback needed." The QA table tests 9.3 only on the editor and Away Assist screens, with no 4.7 device listed.

attacks.claim: Away Assist could trigger on motionless but present occupants, such as people asleep during a scheduled home period. The feature is opt-in and off by default, which limits the exposure, but it has no sleep exclusion and no monitoring metric for false-Away events.
attacks.evidence: "sets Away mode after 2 h with no motion during scheduled 'home' periods"; Monitoring lists no Away Assist metric.

attacks.claim: Stage 1 advances on a boot-revert rate below 0.05%, which is about 3 units out of ~6,100. The paging threshold is 0.1%, so rates between the two thresholds trigger neither a block nor an alert. There is also no minimum observation volume.
attacks.evidence: "boot-revert rate < 0.05%" vs "Pages firmware on-call if boot reverts exceed 0.1% of updated units"

attacks.claim: The 7-day retention statement covers cloud Home/Away state only. The telemetry-ingest copy that the cost section describes has no stated retention.
attacks.evidence: "kept 7 days and then deleted" vs "Home/Away state adds ~1 small event per state change; projected +0.4% on telemetry ingest."

attacks.claim: The statement that freeze and heat protection is never interrupted conflicts with relays being held open for about 90 s during install. The temperature deferral is checked only before install starts.
attacks.evidence: "so freeze/heat protection is never interrupted" vs "During the ~90 s install, relays are held open (off)."

attacks.claim: QA has no rows for power loss or network drop mid-download or mid-swap. Only failed-boot injection is covered, although the A/B slot and signature verification design mitigates the risk.
